data.detailed_description:
A first-person psychological horror game about grief, obsession, and love that explores the extreme ends of human emotion.

You are Nolan, a student who came to Dunmore Street hoping to finish his studies. Explore, connect, and uncover the truth by piecing together hidden clues, memories, and objects in the environment around you, all of which may affect your choices and ending. Search every corner, solve puzzles, meet people, and survive dangerous dream sequences while an entity stalks your every move. You cannot fight back. Your only option is to run, hide, and survive.

Sleep to enter your dreams and take control of them. If you die, you'll fall into deeper dream layers and even more unstable realities, where time passes slower in the real world. But be careful. If you die there, you may never wake up. Keep your dreams stable... before they consume you. Or perhaps, as the line between dreams and reality begins to fade, you'll question whether escaping is truly what you want... and choose to become part of the entity's world instead.

This street has a story. A father loved his daughter so much that the day she came into his life, he wanted the whole street to celebrate with him. But life had other plans, and the celebration didn't last. Things didn't go the way they should have.

Find out what the father did, why it's still happening, and how to end it. The deeper you go, the more you may not want to end it. Maybe you're searching for a better life. Or maybe you're chasing something the real world could never give you.

Think carefully before making a choice. Your goal isn't just to stop what's happening. It's to find the ending you believe is right for yourself... and for this world. Choose whatever you believe is right for you.

Welcome to a perfect, crafted world frozen in time... forever.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: NULL is a psychological horror game centered on the themes of intense parental grief and the death of an infant. While the game avoids graphic gore or sexual violence, it contains disturbing imagery, depictions of non-graphic corpses, and deep emotional distress. The environment features surreal, frightening scenes that may be unsettling for some players.
